passage_flags.claim: Damaged water bodies are also being restored, because healthy ponds and lakes help recharge groundwater.
passage_flags.problem: Booklet lists water body restoration (p.5/p.7 implementation list) but does not state that ponds or lakes recharge groundwater. Groundwater recharge is attributed to the Aravalli rock formations, not to restored water bodies.

passage_flags.claim: Invasive plant species, which crowd out native plants, are removed so that the native forest can recover.
passage_flags.problem: Booklet says only 'Removal of invasive species'. The 'crowd out native plants' and 'native forest can recover' rationale is not in the text.
